title: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 — Section 21 (Award of Lok Adalat)

content.overview: Section 21 makes a Lok Adalat award deemed to be a decree of a civil court and final, with no appeal.
content.glance: Section 21 makes a Lok Adalat award deemed to be a decree of a civil court and final, with no appeal.
content.study: Every award of a Lok Adalat is deemed to be a decree of a civil court. It is final and binding on the parties, and no appeal lies against it. Execution is as a civil-court decree.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 21 makes a Lok Adalat award deemed to be a decree of a civil court and final, with no appeal.
